name: HESG Winter 2027 Meeting
organizer: Health Economists' Study Group (HESG); hosted by Queen Mary University of London
venue: Mile End Campus, Queen Mary University of London
conf_dates_note: Sessions run from 1 p.m. on 13 January to 1 p.m. on 15 January 2027.
deadline_note: Closed. Abstract submission closed on 5 October 2026; papers of accepted abstracts due 7 December 2026.
submission_requirements: Abstract submission; full paper of accepted abstracts due 7 December 2026.
registration_fee: Members GBP 350 until 16 Nov 2026, then GBP 450; non-members GBP 425 until 16 Nov 2026, then GBP 525 (excluding accommodation). PhD students can apply for a scholarship.
